title: Toddler Boy Pushing Toy Wheelbarrow in Yard, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot featuring a determined young toddler pushing a small metal toy wheelbarrow across a gravelly backyard path. The boy is dressed in a knit button-up cardigan, trousers, and a snug cap. Behind him, a small Boston Terrier sits watchfully on the grass near a white picket fence. In the background stands an umbrella-style outdoor rotary clothesline, a bicycle, and a clapboard home framed by large leafy trees, capturing everyday domestic childhood during the mid-20th century.
